title: Carousel Video Ads for Product Stories | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a short video of that one item, shot by shot. Add your headline and price after download. Pick a shape for the post or product page.
h1: Carousel Video Ad That Walks Through One Product
lead: Place one product photo in a scene, add an AI voice or a script, and keep every shot on that one product. This is one video, not a stack of still cards.
steps_h2: How to Make a Carousel Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: The shots stay in the order you write. Set the voice in the editor. Add the headline and price after you download.

steps.d: Upload one photo of the product shoppers will see on the product page. Keep the full item visible.
Name the shots in order, all of this one item. Add a short script and pick 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
Set the voice in the editor, download the file with no watermark, and post it.

faq.q: What is a carousel video ad?
faq.a: One video of a single product, from a first look, to the item in use, then a clear ending. It is a video, not a stack of still cards. You can add an AI voice and an on-screen person. That person is not a customer.

faq.q: How do I make a carousel video ad?
faq.a: Upload one product photo and list the shots in order. Add or edit a script, pick a shape and a length, then download. You can also paste the product page link to write a first script and pick the on-screen person.

faq.q: What products can a carousel video ad show?
faq.a: One item per file: a bag, a bottle, a beauty product, apparel or electronics. Everyday fashion fits, and so does any product you can photograph. Put a second product in another file.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the same photo and make another version for a second audience, a different first line, or another language. Each file shows its cost in credits before it runs. A credit is a unit your plan spends.

faq.q: Who is a carousel video ad for?
faq.a: Fashion and electronics shops, and other stores that want a clip on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, or the product page to walk through one item. You do not have to hire a photographer.
Yes. You do not need editing experience. Upload the photo, adjust the script and the voice in the built-in editor, and download.

faq.q: Where can I post the file?
faq.a: On TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and your product page. Shapes are a tall phone video (9:16), a square (1:1), a wide screen (16:9), a classic photo (4:3), or a tall photo (3:4). The download has no watermark.

A credit is a unit your plan spends. A clip costs 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see the number before it starts. If the clip fails, those credits come back. Plans start at $24.50 a month.
No. There is no free plan. Plans start at $24.50 a month, and the download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or an API?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page link to write a first scene, a script, and the on-screen person. You can also send the photo through the API. The API is how your own shop software starts the clip. Check the product in the file before you post.

faq.q: Can the voice be in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Make the same clip with a voice in another language, and approve the words before you post.
